name: Micri
title: Benjaminitic Patriarch
summary: Micri is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as part of the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin. He is known as the father of Shimei and is one of the Benjamite families who settled in Jerusalem after the exile. His significance lies in his place in the genealogy that connects the tribe of Benjamin to the rebuilding of Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Micri is mentioned as part of the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin in 1 Chronicles, where the family lines of the tribe are recorded.

keyEvents.title: Connection to the Inhabitants of Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Micri's descendants were among the Benjamites who settled in Jerusalem, demonstrating the tribe's role in the holy city.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Heritage of the Tribe of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Micri is part of the broader genealogy that documents the heritage and family lines of the tribe of Benjamin through generations.

keyEvents.title: Genealogical Line Linked to Gibeon
keyEvents.description: Micri's family is connected to the Gibeonites and the Benjamite clans who had their base in the Gibeon area.
